mapper.select: SELECT * FROM recovery_code WHERE request_id=#{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE recovery_code SET send_status='INVALID' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND purpose=#{purpose} AND send_status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE')
UPDATE recovery_code SET send_status='INVALID' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND send_status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE')
UPDATE recovery_code SET send_status='INVALID' WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND send_status='PENDING'

UPDATE recovery_code SET send_status='ACTIVE' WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND send_status='PENDING' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user u WHERE u.user_id=recovery_code.user_id AND u.status=1 AND u.is_deleted=0 AND u.credential_version=recovery_code.credential_version)
UPDATE recovery_code SET attempts=attempts+1 WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND send_status='ACTIVE' AND attempts < 5 AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE recovery_code SET consumed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), send_status='CONSUMED' WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND send_status='ACTIVE' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND attempts < 5 AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recovery_rate_lock(scope_key) VALUES(#{key}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope_key=#{key}
mapper.select: SELECT scope_key FROM recovery_rate_lock WHERE scope_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT created_at FROM recovery_rate_event WHERE scope_key=#{key} AND created_at > #{cutoff} ORDER BY created_at DESC FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recovery_rate_event WHERE scope_key=#{key} AND created_at <= #{cutoff}
